name: claude-plain-style
description: A Claude Code plugin that adds a plain-style writing rule (STYLE.md) to every prompt, so reviews, reports and docs state the conclusion first, then the evidence, without metaphors or slogans. Rules are written in Chinese.

plugins.name: plain-style
plugins.description: 每次提问前自动注入 STYLE.md 输出风格规则，让周报、说明、文档这类写给人看的文字只讲事实，不编细节、不用修辞。
